Let \(z=x+iy\). The second equation becomes
\[
|z-(4+k)|=|z-(k+3i)|,
\]
so \(z\) lies on the perpendicular bisector of the points \((4+k,0)\) and \((k,3)\). This gives
\[
(x-(4+k))^2+y^2=(x-k)^2+(y-3)^2,
\]
which simplifies to
\[
4x-3y-4k-\frac72=0.
\]
The first equation is the circle
\[
(x-25)^2+(y-20)^2=25.
\]
For exactly one complex solution, the line must be tangent to the circle, so the distance from \((25,20)\) to the line equals \(5\):
\[
\frac{|4(25)-3(20)-4k-\frac72|}{5}=5.
\]
Thus
\[
\left|\frac{73}{2}-4k\right|=25
\]
or
\[
|73-8k|=50.
\]
So
\[
73-8k=50 \Rightarrow k=\frac{23}{8},
\]
or
\[
73-8k=-50 \Rightarrow k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]
The sum of all possible values of \(k\) is
\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
Thus \(m=73,\ n=4\), and \(m+n=77\).

ANSWER: 77
